traits.name: brave
traits.reason: No costly builds or tense moments appear; only routine walking, gathering and eating, with no calm conflict statements to judge.

traits.name: cheerful
traits.reason: Reports like 'Shift done' are upbeat in a mild way, but they are terse and carry no flourish.

traits.name: steadfast
traits.reason: Activity stays in a tight area around (75-82, 103-109) and wood is gathered steadily, but stores and farm are never mentioned as duty.

traits.name: protective
traits.reason: Greeted a visitor twice and offered to trade, but it named the peer Toffeetrowel and showed no stocking of the storehouse for teammates.
